messages.content: Find out about traffic laws in Texas.

function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
Sure! Here’s an overview of some key traffic laws and regulations you’ll find in Texas: | Topic | Key Points | |-------|------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits vary by road type (e.g., 55 mph on rural interstates, 45 mph on urban interstates).
• “No‑limit” highways allow speeds up to 75 mph if conditions permit. | | **Seat Belt & Child Restraint** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | | **Cell Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited unless using a hands‑free system. | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21. | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • At uncontrolled intersections, vehicles turning left must yield to straight‑going traffic.
• Pedestrians have priority at crosswalks. | | **School Bus Laws** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus stops to pick up or drop off children. | | **Lane‑Changing & Passing** | • Must signal, check mirrors, and ensure safe gaps. | | **Traffic Signal Violations** | • Running red lights, stopping at a green light, or ignoring stop signs can lead to fines and points. | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking in front of driveways, fire hydrants, or within 20 ft of a stop sign. | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Proof of insurance must be carried; registration stickers must be displayed. | For more detailed statutes, consult the Texas Transportation Code or the Texas Department of Motor Vehicles website. If you’re looking for specific case law or recent legal developments, let me know and I can help locate relevant cases.
